note: Unpublished Paragraphs is a front-end-only helper for the Paragraphs module. It defines no config, no permission, no Drush, no plugins. On non-admin routes hook_preprocess_paragraph() adds CSS classes 'paragraph' + 'unpublished' to any paragraph where $paragraph->isPublished() is FALSE and attaches the unpublished_paragraphs/unpublished-toggle library (CSS hides .paragraph.unpublished; JS appends a fixed 'Toggle visibility of unpublished items' button that toggles them). It grants no access itself. Because the module has no config of its own, the medium/hard cases are grounded in the one thing it actually keys on: a Paragraph entity's published status. They use a self-contained, namespaced fixture built by the setup/reset scripts: paragraph type up_text (field field_up_body), content type up_page with paragraphs field field_up_paras, and nodes containing published/unpublished paragraphs. Cleanup removes the whole up_* fixture by name (never an unscoped field purge).

evals.prompt: After enabling the unpublished_paragraphs module, how does a viewer show or hide unpublished paragraphs on a rendered page, and when does the control appear?
evals.expected_output: The module attaches a library that appends a fixed 'Toggle visibility of unpublished items' button in the bottom-right corner, but only on pages that actually contain an unpublished paragraph. Clicking it shows/hides every unpublished paragraph on the page.

evals.prompt: What CSS classes and asset library does the unpublished_paragraphs module add to an unpublished paragraph when it is rendered, and what does the CSS do by default?
evals.expected_output: hook_preprocess_paragraph() adds the classes 'paragraph' and 'unpublished' and attaches the unpublished_paragraphs/unpublished-toggle library. The CSS hides .paragraph.unpublished by default (display:none) and marks it with a pink dotted border and an 'Unpublished' label.

evals.prompt: Does the unpublished_paragraphs module define its own permission or settings page, and on which routes does it act? What paragraph property does it check?
evals.expected_output: It has no settings page and defines no permission of its own; it only acts on non-admin routes (isAdminRoute() is FALSE) via hook_preprocess_paragraph, checking $paragraph->isPublished(). Whether an unpublished paragraph renders at all is governed by core Paragraphs / entity access.

evals.prompt: This site has a node called 'UP Fixture Node' built with Paragraphs (relevant to the unpublished_paragraphs module). One of its paragraphs is unpublished. Inspect the live site and state the body text of the paragraph that is unpublished.
evals.expected_output: The unpublished paragraph's field_up_body is 'Secret unpublished block' (its status is 0), while 'Published intro block' is published.

evals.prompt: On this site there is exactly one node built with Paragraphs that contains an unpublished paragraph. Inspect the live site and give the title of that node.
evals.expected_output: The node is titled 'UP Fixture Node' (a up_page node whose field_up_paras includes a paragraph with status 0).

evals.prompt: On this site the node 'UP Toggle Node' contains a paragraph whose body text is 'Toggle target block' and it is currently published. So that the unpublished_paragraphs module will hide it behind its toggle, unpublish that paragraph. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The paragraph whose field_up_body is 'Toggle target block' has status 0 (unpublished), e.g. load it and call setUnpublished()->save().

evals.prompt: This site has a content type up_page with a paragraphs reference field field_up_paras and a paragraph type up_text (body field field_up_body). Create a node titled 'UP Task Node' of type up_page that contains at least one unpublished up_text paragraph (so the unpublished_paragraphs module would mark and hide it). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A up_page node titled 'UP Task Node' exists whose field_up_paras references at least one paragraph with status 0 (unpublished).
